title: Text cut off by the output token limit
summary: The model stops at the output token limit in the middle of a plain-text answer.

messages.content: Write a 200-word paragraph about how octopuses change colour to hide from predators.
Write a 200-word paragraph about the history of Kyiv, in English.

requirements.text: The caller can tell that the output stopped at the token limit.
The partial text is reported exactly as the provider sent it.
Token usage is reported, and matches the provider's counts.

grading_notes: A finish reason of length satisfies the first requirement, and so does a dedicated truncation error, which some libraries raise instead of returning the partial text. Such a library gets a note for the text requirement, a SHOULD, and keeps its grade. Effort none disables reasoning where supported. Gemini maps it to MINIMAL, which may still consume some of the limit on thoughts. The openai-chat fixture was recorded with an earlier prompt, which the override keeps; every other provider uses the current one. Anthropic effort none sends no thinking configuration: Sonnet 5.5 keeps adaptive thinking enabled.
